ElementDescription: The NDAR Global Unique Identifier (GUID) for research subject
Subject ID how it's defined in lab/project
Date on which the interview/genetic test/sampling/imaging/biospecimen was completed. MM/DD/YYYY
Age in months at the time of the interview/test/sampling/imaging.
Notes: Age is rounded to chronological month. If the research participant is 15-days-old at time of interview, the appropriate value would be 0 months. If the participant is 16-days-old, the value would be 1 month.

ElementDescription: Sex of subject at birth
Notes: M = Male; F = Female; O=Other; NR = Not reported

ElementDescription: Over the past 3 months, have you been bothered by pain? By pain, we are talking about physical pain
Notes: 0= No; 1= Yes; -99= NA/RF

ElementDescription: Over the past 3 months, have you been bothered by pain on at least half the days?
Notes: 0= No; 1= Yes; -99= NA/RF

ElementDescription: In the past 7 days, how would you rate your pain on average (on a 0 to 10 scale where 0 is no pain and 10 is the worst imaginable pain)?
Notes: 0= 0 No pain; 10= 10 Worst imaginable pain; -99= NA/RF

ElementDescription: In the past 7 days, how much did pain interfere with your day-to-day activities (on a 0 to 10 scale where 0 is no interference and 10 is completely interferes)?
Notes: 0= 0 No interference; 10= 10 Completely interferes; -99= NA/RF

ElementDescription: In the past 3 months, how often did you have pain?
Notes: 1= Never; 2= Some days; 3= Most days; 4= Every day

ElementDescription: Over the past 3 months, how often did pain limit your life or work activities?
Notes: 1= Never; 2= Some days; 3= Most days; 4= Every day

ElementDescription: During the past 7 days, what number best describes how pain has interfered with your enjoyment of life?
Notes: 0= 0 No interference; 10= 10 Completely interferes

ElementDescription: Are you not working or unable work due to pain or a pain condition?
Notes: 0= No; 1= Yes

ElementDescription: Widespread pain or pain in most of your body
Notes: 0=Not bothered at all; 1=Bothered a little; 2=Bothered a lot

ElementDescription: How long has your [cpa_pain] pain been an ongoing problem for you?
Notes: 0=Less than 1 month; 1=1-3 months; 2=3-6 months; 3= 6 months-1 year; 4=1-5 years; 5=More than 5 years

ElementDescription: Which area of the body is associated with chronic pain? If multiple areas, enter the area that is most problematic.
Are there any other areas of chronic pain?
Notes: 0=No; 1=Yes

ElementDescription: Do you experience chronic pain?
Notes: 0=No; 1=Yes

ElementDescription: Stomach pain
Notes: 0=Not bothered at all; 1=Bothered a little; 2=Bothered a lot

ElementDescription: Headaches
Notes: 0=Not bothered at all; 1=Bothered a little; 2=Bothered a lot

ElementDescription: Pain in your arms, legs, or joints other than your spine or back
Notes: 0=Not bothered at all; 1=Bothered a little; 2=Bothered a lot

ElementDescription: Timepoint/visit label
Notes: e.g., Baseline, 6-Month Follow Up, Year 2; Morning, At Bedtime

ElementDescription: Please list the area(s) of ADDITIONAL chronic pain:
Has your [cpa_pain] pain spread to other parts of your body during the past 2 weeks?
Notes: 0=No; 1=Yes; 2=Not sure

ElementDescription: In the past 7 days, how would you rate your [cpa_pain] pain on average?
Notes: 1=No pain; 10=Worst imaginable pain

ElementDescription: Have you had an operation or surgery for your [cpa_pain] pain related problem?
Notes: 0=No; 1=Yes, one operation; 2=Yes, more than one operation

ElementDescription: How often has [cpa_pain] pain been an ongoing problem for you over the past 6 months?
Notes: 0=Every day or nearly every day in the past 6 months; 1=At least half the days in the past 6 months; 2=Less than half the days in the past 6 months

ElementDescription: Did any of your operations/surgeries involve a spinal fusion? (also called an arthrodesis)
Notes: 0=No; 1=Yes; 2=Not sure

ElementDescription: If yes, when was your last operation/surgery?
Notes: 0=Less than 6 months ago; 1=More than 6 months ago but less than 1 year ago; 2=Between 1 and 2 years ago; 3=More than 2 years ago
